need: Expose typed repeatable common filters and expressive deterministic advanced filters with explainable local re-evaluation.

discovery.stop_condition: Established direct parser and established local JSON query language found.

contenders.name: Click
evidence: official docs cover multiple typed options and CliRunner

contenders.name: Typer over Click
evidence: duplicates the selected parser role without a surviving annotation-driven requirement

contenders.name: custom filter DSL or Python eval
evidence: recreates parsing and creates a security/compatibility surface

decision_effect: Click owns command parsing; JMESPath evaluates --where after hard gates and typed flags; coordinator code owns explanation and unknown semantics.
reconsider_when: A measured expression required by real users cannot be represented safely in JMESPath
